Our Story

Same Kitchen.
New Name.

Port St. Lucie's favorite food truck grew up. For years, The Dog Pound slung legendary lobster rolls and loaded comfort food out of the truck — and now it's got a name and a home to match: Mac's Restaurant.

Same crew. Same recipes people drive across town for. Just more seafood, more room, and the same rule we've always had — cook it fresh, cook it hard, send everybody home happy.

What we serve
